caption: The drawing depicts a long, curved, wooden panel with a predominantly brown background. On the left side, there is an ornate, golden scrollwork design surrounding a blue ribbon that contains the word "BRIDGET" written in gold letters. Moving to the right, there are images of stacked barrels, baskets, and chests, depicted in brown and yellow tones. To the far right, there is a woven basket filled with round, brown objects, possibly fruit or vegetables. Near the end of the panel, there is a draped blue cloth with a gold edge, and at the very tip, a small section of a red and gold decorative element is visible. The background of the image is a plain, light cream color, and the artist’s signature, “Beverly Chichester,” is written in small letters on the right side beneath the panel.
title: Nameboard from Schooner
